Cherry Restaurant – Vietnamese Cuisine

A wonderful place to enjoy Vietnamese cuisine! Cherry Restaurant offers delicious food, a comfortable dining environment and, above all, excellent and friendly service.

We particularly enjoyed the fresh Vietnamese spring rolls, filled with fresh vegetables, aromatic herbs, vermicelli and grilled meatballs. What made the experience special was the staff's thoughtful demonstration of how to make our own spring rolls. It was fun, interactive and a great way to experience Vietnamese food culture!

The staff were attentive, patient and welcoming throughout the meal, making us feel genuinely well taken care of. The restaurant also offers a good variety of Vietnamese dishes in a pleasant setting.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City! If you're looking for tasty Vietnamese food, warm hospitality and an enjoyable dining experience, Cherry Restaurant is definitely worth a visit.

⭐ Verdict: Delicious food, outstanding service and a memorable Vietnamese dining experience. Definitely worth visiting!

📍 11B Thái Văn Lung, Ho Chi Minh City
